name: City Council Special Meeting  - Mayoral Installation/City Council Reorganization
agenda_text:
City Council of Monterey Park
  The City Council Acting on Behalf of the Successor Agency of the Former Redevelopment
 Agency, the Housing Authority, the Monterey Park Financing Authority and the Monterey Park
  Geologic Hazard Abatement District Agenda

  Special Meeting
  Monterey Park City Hall Council Chambers
  320 W. Newmark Avenue, Monterey Park, CA 91754

  Tuesday, June 30, 2026
  6:00 PM
  Mission Statement
The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth and opportunity,
  and create a joyous and collaborative environment.
  Land Acknowledgment
We would like to acknowledge that the land we inhabit today was once known as Tovangaar, the home
 of the Gabrieleño-Tongva people. We show our respect to the Gabrieleño-Tongva people, as well as
  all Indigenous people, past, present, and future, and honor their labor as original caretakers of this
land. We commit to uplifting the Gabrieleño-Tongva people, invite you to acknowledge the history, and
  join us in caring for this land.

General Information
Documents related to an Agenda item are available to the public in the City Clerk’s Office located at
320 West Newmark Avenue, Monterey Park, CA 91754, during normal business hours and at
wwww.montereypark.ca.gov/agendas.

The public may watch the meeting live on the city’s cable channel MPKTV (AT&T U-verse, channel 99
or Charter Communications, channel 182) or by visiting the city’s website
at http://www.montereypark.ca.gov/133/City-Council-Meeting-Videos.

Per the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting,
please email City Hall at mpclerk@montereypark.ca.gov or call (626) 307-1359 for reasonable
accommodation at least 8 hours before a meeting. Interpretation requests are not guaranteed and are
dependent on availability. Requester will be notified of availability. Council Chambers are wheelchair
accessible.

Pursuant to Government Code § 54954.3(a), the public may address the City Council only on matters
listed on this Agenda. No other public comment will be accepted. Pursuant to Rule 5 of Resolution No.
12226 (adopted February 17, 2021), speakers are limited to a total of five minutes for Public Comment.
If desirable, the Mayor and City Council may change the amount of time allowed for speakers. Written
Communication will be accepted up to 3 hours before the meeting by completing an online form
at www.montereypark.ca.gov/writtencomm.
 The City Council will recess into Closed Session following public comment and the Open Session
items, if any. Public participation is not allowed during Closed Session.

  Minutes
  Monterey Park City Council
  Financing Authority (MPFA)
  Housing Authority (MPHA)
  Geologic Hazard Abatement District (GHAD)
  Successor Agency (SA)
  Special Meeting
  June 30, 2026
The City Council, the Financing Authority (MPFA), the Housing Authority (MPHA), the
Geologic Hazard Abatement District (GHAD), and the Successor Agency (SA) of the
City of Monterey Park held a Special Meeting of the Council in the Council Chamber,
located at 320 West Newmark Avenue in the City of Monterey Park, Tuesday, June 30,
2026, at 6:00 p.m.

1.  Call to Order
  Mayor Yang called the meeting to order at 6:12 p.m.

2.  Flag Salute
  The Monterey Park Police Color Guard led the flag salute.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance
  Civic Superstars Mia, Dolly and Bella Sanchez led the Pledge of Allegiance.

4.  Roll Call
  City Clerk Maychelle Yee called the roll:

  Council Members Present: Henry Lo, Vinh Ngo, Jose Sanchez, Thomas Wong
  arrived at 6:24 p.m., Elizabeth Yang
  Council Members Absent: None

  Also present:
  City Treasurer Amy Lee
  City Manager Inez Alvarez
  Assistant City Manager Diana Garcia
  Director of Finance Martha Garcia
  Director of Human Resources and Risk Management Christine Tomikawa
  Director of Recreation and Community Services Robert Aguirre
  City Librarian Kristin Olivarez
  Director of Public Works Shawn Igoe
  Police Chief Scott Wiese
  Fire Chief Jason Hing
  Library Manager Linda Vera
  Principal Management Analyst Rebecca Bojorquez

  Mission Statement
The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth
  and opportunity, and create a joyous and collaborative environment
   74-276
  June 30, 2026

  Deputy City Clerk Cindy Trang
  Assistant Deputy City Clerk Helena Cho
  Administrative Aid Megan Cheung
  Office Assistant Michelle Martinez

  Virtually present:
  None.

5.  Telecommunications Announcement, if requested
  None.

6.  Agenda Revisions and Additions
  None.

7.  Public Comments
  Outgoing Mayor Yang recognized special guests in attendance, which included
  former City of Monterey Park Mayors David Lau, Mike Ng and Yvonne Yiu; City of
  San Gabriel Council Member and Former Mayor Denise Menchaca; Los Angeles
  County Assessor Jeff Prang; City of Cerritos former Council Member and former
  Mayor Frank Yokoyama; Garvey Unified School District President Andy Yam and
  Board Member John Nuñez; City of West Hollywood Mayor Pro Tem Danny Hang;
  Chinese Consolidated Benevolent Association Vice Chairman Danny Leung;
  Chinese American Unity Alliance President Derek Ma; Chinese American Citizens
  Alliance President Shirley Hwong; City Commissioners serving the City of
  Monterey Park; former City Clerk Vincent Chang; Representative of the Center for
  Asian Americans United for Self-Empowerment (CAUSE) and State Senator Ben
  Allen’s Office, Sophia Pu; District Director of Assemblymember Mike Fong's Office,
  Jennifer Love Tang and Representative of State Senator Sasha Renée Pérez’s
  Office, Amber Giang.

8.  New Business

  8.A. Outgoing Address by Mayor Elizabeth Yang
  Outgoing Mayor Yang delivered her outgoing City Council address, conveying
  the accomplishments achieved during her term as Mayor. She elaborated on
  her appreciation for her fellow City Council members and City staff for their
  collaborative efforts in maintaining the City.

  The City Council presented outgoing Mayor Yang with a plaque honoring her
  role as Mayor of the City of Monterey Park.
   74-277
  June 30, 2026

8.B. Reorganization of Monterey Park City Council
  Recommendations:
  It is recommended that the City Council consider:

  1. Appointing the Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem in accordance with City
  Council policy established by Resolution No. 11507; and
  2. Taking such additional, related action that may be desirable.

  Action Taken: The City Council approved the recommendation.

  Motion: Moved by Council Member Ngo and seconded by Council Member
  Wong, motion carried by the following vote:

  Ayes: Council Members: Henry Lo, Vinh Ngo, Jose Sanchez, Thomas Wong,
  Elizabeth Yang
  Noes: Council Members: None
  Absent: Council Members: None
  Abstain: Council Members: None
  Recusal: Council Members: None

8.C. Mayor Pro Tem Installation of Jose Sanchez
  City Clerk Yee introduced Andres Sanchez to administer the Oath of
  Affirmation to Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez and introduced Mia, Dolly and Bella
  Sanchez to present him with his badge and cards.

  Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez shared words of appreciation to his fellow Council
  Members and to his family and commented on Monterey Park's achievements
  throughout his term of the City Council.

8.D. Mayoral Installation of Henry Lo
  City Clerk Yee introduced Los Angeles County Assessor Jeff Prang to
  administer the Oath of Affirmation to Mayor Lo and introduced Daisy Ma to
  present him with his badge and cards.

8.E. Presentations

  • Pastor Abner Ramos shared inspirational comments and provided a
  prayer to the City Council.

  • Mike Eng, representing Congresswoman Judy Chu and the San
  Gabriel Valley Municipal Water District, shared words of appreciation
  and presented certificates to Mayor Lo, Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez and
  City Council Member Yang.
   74-278
  June 30, 2026

• Amber Giang, representing State Senator Sasha Renée Pérez, spoke
  words of gratitude to Mayor Lo, Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez and Council
  Member Yang and shared certificates in their honor.

• Sophia Pu, representing CAUSE, and State Senator Ben Allen, offered
  certificates of recognition to Mayor Lo, Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez and
  Council Member Yang.

• Jennifer Love Tang, District Director of Assemblymember Mike Fong's
  office, commented on the City's efforts to ban data centers in Monterey
  Park and dedicated certificates to Mayor Lo, Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez
  and Council Member Yang.

• Denise Menchaca, Council Member of the City of San Gabriel,
  exhibited her appreciation to the City Council and bestowed certificates
  to Mayor Lo, Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez and Council Member Yang.

• Danny Hang, Vice Mayor of the City of West Hollywood, alongside
  Catherine Eng, Public Safety Commissioner for the City of West
  Hollywood, presented certificates in appreciation to Mayor Lo, Mayor
  Pro Tem Sanchez and Council Member Yang.

• Frank Aurelio Yokoyama, Council Member of the City of Cerritos,
  dedicated certificates of gratitude to Mayor Lo, Mayor Pro Tem
  Sanchez and City Council Member Yang for their dedication to serving
  the City.

• Los Angeles County Assessor Jeff Prang spoke words of recognition
  and exhibited certificates to Mayor Lo, Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez and
  Council Member Yang.

• President Andrew Yam, Superintendent Anita Chu, and Board Member
  John H. Nunez from the Garvey Unified School District, expressed
  words of appreciation and demonstrated certificates of recognition to
  Mayor Lo, Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez and Council Member Yang.

• Alan Alexander, representing the Organization of Chinese Americans
  (OCA) - Asian Pacific American Advocates of Greater Los Angeles,
  shared words of gratitude and presented certificates to Mayor Lo and to
  Council Member Yang.
   74-279
  June 30, 2026

  • Shirley Hwong, President of the Community Participation Commission
  and member of the Chinese American Citizen Alliance of San Gabriel
  Valley spoke words of appreciation towards the City Council and to
  Mayor Lo, Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez and to Council Member Yang.

  • Connie Vuong, Daisy Ma, and Gay Yuen from the Chinese American
  Citizens Alliance, Los Angeles Lodge, spoke words of recognition and
  shared certificates with Mayor Lo and Council Member Yang.

  8.F. Mayor's Address
  Mayor Lo commented about his time as Mayor during his first term on the
  Monterey Park City Council and the accomplishments he and his fellow City
  Council Members have achieved throughout the years. He shared his
  enthusiasm for serving as Mayor for the second time his goals to improve the
  quality of life for the residents.

9.  Adjournment
  There being no further business for consideration, the meeting was adjourned at
  7:56 p.m.

  _____________________
  Maychelle Yee
  City Clerk

  Approved on August 19, 2026 at the regular City Council Meeting
